actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.search_clips.description: Search and retrieve video clips from KLIPY's database by keyword or phrase.
actions.search_clips.props.content_filte: Set the content safety level for the results.
actions.search_clips.props.customer_id.d: A unique identifier for the end user in your system. Used to personalize results. Keep this consistent for the same user.
actions.search_clips.props.locale.descri: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 country code to boost results for a specific region (e.g. "us", "uk", "de"). Leave empty for global results.
actions.search_clips.props.page.descript: Which page of results to return. Starts at 1.
actions.search_clips.props.per_page.desc: Number of clips to return per page. Must be between 8 and 50.
actions.search_clips.props.q.description: The keyword or phrase to search for (e.g. "funny cat", "celebration"). Leave empty to browse trending clips.
actions.search_gifs.description: Search and retrieve GIFs from KLIPY's database by keyword or phrase.
actions.search_gifs.props.content_filter: Set the content safety level for the results.
actions.search_gifs.props.customer_id.de: A unique identifier for the end user in your system. Used to personalize results. Keep this consistent for the same user.
Comma-separated list of formats to include in results. Possible values: gif, webp, jpg, mp4, webm. Leave empty to include all formats.
actions.search_gifs.props.locale.descrip: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 country code to boost results for a specific region (e.g. "us", "uk", "de"). Leave empty for global results.
actions.search_gifs.props.page.descripti: Which page of results to return. Starts at 1.
actions.search_gifs.props.per_page.descr: Number of GIFs to return per page. Must be between 8 and 50.
actions.search_gifs.props.q.description: The keyword or phrase to search for (e.g. "hello", "happy birthday"). Leave empty to browse trending GIFs.
actions.search_stickers.description: Search and retrieve stickers from KLIPY's database by keyword or phrase.
actions.search_stickers.props.content_fi: Set the content safety level for the results.
actions.search_stickers.props.customer_i: A unique identifier for the end user in your system. Used to personalize results. Keep this consistent for the same user.
actions.search_stickers.props.format_fil: Comma-separated list of formats to include in results. Possible values: gif, webp, png, webm. Leave empty to include all formats.
actions.search_stickers.props.locale.des: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 country code to boost results for a specific region (e.g. "us", "uk", "de"). Leave empty for global results.
actions.search_stickers.props.page.descr: Which page of results to return. Starts at 1.
actions.search_stickers.props.per_page.d: Number of stickers to return per page. Must be between 8 and 50.
actions.search_stickers.props.q.descript: The keyword or phrase to search for (e.g. "love", "thumbs up"). Leave empty to browse trending stickers.
auth.description:
To get your App Key:
1. Sign in to your KLIPY account at https://klipy.com
2. Go to your dashboard and open **API Settings**
3. Copy your **App Key**

The App Key is a unique identifier issued by KLIPY for your application.
